projects.title: Web-Based Church Management System
projects.context: Archdiocese of Kota Kinabalu · Final Year Project
projects.summary: A web-based system that brings church information, announcements, bulletins, events, sacraments, pastoral care, catechesis and donations for the 23 churches in Kota Kinabalu into one place, with separate access for members, church admins and a super admin.
projects.problem: Church information, bulletins, announcements and services across the 23 churches in Kota Kinabalu needed a single, central web platform.
projects.approach: Following the Waterfall methodology: requirements analysis, database design, implementation and testing. Built in plain PHP with PDO and MySQL, with three roles: member, church admin and super admin.
features: Church directory with priests, mass times and contact details
Announcements and digital bulletins, with email notifications to subscribers
Event registration with capacity limits and email reminders
Sacrament applications, schedules and confession slot booking
Pastoral care requests with admin review
Catechesis enrolment and attendance tracking
Donations with receipt upload, admin review and reports
AI assistant and AI-assisted announcement writing (Gemini API)
projects.outcome: Currently in development as my Final Year Project.

projects.title: SchoolFam
projects.summary: An AI-powered parent–school communication platform that brings classroom updates, attendance, pickup, health, billing and messaging together for parents, teachers and school admins.
projects.problem: Parents and schools communicate through scattered channels, so daily updates, absences, pickups, fees and incidents are easy to miss.
projects.approach: Built as a browser-based React and TypeScript prototype in Google AI Studio, with role-based screens for parents, teachers, admins and a super admin, realistic sample data, and a Gemini-powered daily summary for parents.
features: Daily activity feed and photo moments
AI Smart Daily Summary for parents (Gemini)
Attendance tracking and absence requests
Pickup management with guardian verification and on-screen signature
Health records and incident reports with parent acknowledgement
Chat, announcements and notifications
Calendar with RSVPs
Billing with proof-of-payment verification, and a school shop
Feedback tickets, homework and signed documents
Invite and access codes for teacher and parent sign-up
projects.outcome: Received Overall Best Project recognition and achieved first runner-up in a Technopreneurship Business Idea Pitching competition.

projects.title: StudyUsia
projects.summary: An Android app for booking college study rooms: students check which rooms are free for a date and time, reserve them without clashes, manage their bookings and rate the rooms they used.
projects.problem: Students need a simple way to find a free study room and reserve it without two people booking the same room at the same time.
projects.approach: Built as a native Android app in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose. All data is stored on the device in SQLite, and every booking is checked against the room's opening hours, available dates and existing bookings before it is saved.
features: Student registration and sign-in that remembers the user on the device
Study room list with photos, capacity, location and facilities
Availability search by date and time across all rooms
Clash-free booking that respects each room's opening hours and dates
View, edit and cancel your own bookings
1–5 star ratings and comments for rooms
Admin-protected screens to add, edit and delete rooms
Profile editing

projects.title: UniFest
projects.context: Campus event management system · Team project
projects.summary: A web-based campus event system where students, staff and the public browse and register for university events, organisers manage their events and participants, and admins approve events and manage users.
projects.problem: University events are announced in many places, so students miss them, and organisers have no single place to track registrations, participants and feedback.
projects.approach: Built in PHP with PDO and MySQL, with role-based access for admins, staff, students and public users. Events go through an approval step before they are listed, and passwords are stored with password_hash.
features: Event listings by type (workshop, seminar, competition, festival, sport, course) and mode (physical, online, hybrid)
Public or university-only events, shown only after admin approval
One-click event registration that prevents duplicate sign-ups and notifies the organiser
Participant lists with CSV export and update messages to participants
In-app notifications and simulated email notifications
Event ratings and feedback
Admin reports, user management and role promotion
User profiles with password change

projects.title: Cover Letter Editor
projects.summary: A browser-based tool that tailors my internship cover letter to each company: type the company’s name and address, check a live A4 preview, and download a one-page PDF or Word file.
projects.problem: Sending the same cover letter to many companies meant re-editing the company details, date and wording by hand for every application.
projects.approach: A single offline web page with a live A4 preview. The PDF is generated in the browser with jsPDF, so nothing is uploaded, and personal details are kept out of the public code in git-ignored local files.
features: Live A4 preview while typing
One-click PDF download, automatically fitted to one page
Word download and copy as plain text
Date filled in automatically (e.g. 19th October 2026)
Company name inserted into the letter text
Required-field checks before downloading
Personal details and signature kept in local, git-ignored files
